name: motionmaxxing
description: Looksmaxxing for motion graphics. An agent skill that turns AI slop videos into films that look made by a motion designer.
readme: Your keyframes get a face rating: first the default (mid), then the measured version (maxxed). Typography and vector only, no photo of anyone, made with the skill's own runtime. Watch the MP4 · how it was made and checked An agent skill that turns AI slop videos into films that look made by a motion designer.
